anon_mkdir_write_enable.description: anon_mkdir_write_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#anon_mkdir_write_enable=YES).

anon_upload_enable.description: anon_upload_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#anon_upload_enable=YES).

anonymous_enable.description: anonymous_enable (as documented in the shipped file).

ascii_download_enable.description: ascii_download_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ascii_download_enable=YES).

ascii_upload_enable.description: ascii_upload_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ascii_upload_enable=YES).

async_abor_enable.description: async_abor_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#async_abor_enable=YES).

banned_email_file.description: banned_email_file (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#banned_email_file=/etc/vsftpd/banned_emails).

chown_uploads.description: chown_uploads (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#chown_uploads=YES).

chown_username.description: chown_username (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#chown_username=whoever).

chroot_list_enable.description: Enable the chroot user list file (see chroot_list_file). If set, only users *not* in the list will be chrooted (if chroot_local_user=YES). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#chroot_list_enable=YES).

chroot_list_file.description: Path to file listing users to exempt from chroot jail (if chroot_list_enable=YES and chroot_local_user=YES). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#chroot_list_file=/etc/vsftpd/chroot_list).

chroot_local_user.description: Restrict local users to their home directories (chroot jail). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#chroot_local_user=YES).

connect_from_port_20.description: connect_from_port_20 (as documented in the shipped file).

data_connection_timeout.description: Time (seconds) before idle data connections are closed (0 = no timeout). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#data_connection_timeout=120).

deny_email_enable.description: deny_email_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#deny_email_enable=YES).

dirmessage_enable.description: dirmessage_enable (as documented in the shipped file).

ftpd_banner.description: Banner message displayed to users before authentication. Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ftpd_banner=Welcome to blah FTP service.).

idle_session_timeout.description: Time (seconds) before idle sessions are disconnected (0 = no timeout). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#idle_session_timeout=600).

listen.description: Run vsftpd as a standalone daemon (not under inetd/xinetd).

listen_ipv6.description: Listen on IPv6 in addition to IPv4 (requires IPv6 support and listen=YES).

local_enable.description: Allow local (system) users to log in to the FTP server.

local_umask.description: local_umask (as documented in the shipped file).

ls_recurse_enable.description: ls_recurse_enable (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#ls_recurse_enable=YES).

nopriv_user.description: nopriv_user (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#nopriv_user=ftpsecure).

pam_service_name.description: pam_service_name (as documented in the shipped file).

userlist_enable.description: Enable the user list file (userlist_file) to control access.

write_enable.description: Enable write operations (upload, delete, rename, etc.) for authenticated users.

xferlog_enable.description: xferlog_enable (as documented in the shipped file).

xferlog_file.description: xferlog_file (as documented in the shipped file). Unset keeps the shipped commented line (#xferlog_file=/var/log/xferlog).

xferlog_std_format.description: xferlog_std_format (as documented in the shipped file).
